correctness.rationale: The exact conditional intensity is q(E-D)/binom(k+B,k); binomial birth concentration gives its rank-dependent summability. For k=2 a localized martingale strong law first bounds D by O(log n), then summable intensity errors give A_n-(2q²/p²)log n -> finite a.s. Bounded martingale differences with predictable variance asymptotic to (2q²/p²)log n give a normal CLT. The first Betti difference follows exactly from E-V+components. Independent rational enumeration checked 542 conditional intensities; finite simulation remains diagnostic only.

value.rationale: The graph-versus-hypergraph rank boundary changes the almost-sure long-run count of discarded repeat trials from infinitely many to finitely many. In rank 2 the exact count is the multigraph-to-simple first Betti discrepancy, whose logarithmic fluctuations are on a scale hidden by extensive Betti analysis; hence the result supplies a natural topology-sensitive correction to a model expressly analyzed via Betti numbers, with a fully identified rate and distribution, not an arbitrary finite cutoff.
